blocks.text: Luxury Wellness and Mental Health Retreat for UAE Residents
Exclusive Private One to One Retreat for Burnout Recovery, Mental Health, Detox and Advanced Holistic Wellness.
Alive Luxury Retreats offers exclusive private wellness and mental health retreats for clients from the UAE and Gulf region seeking a higher level of care, privacy, and transformation.

Designed for guests from Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and across the Middle East, our retreats are fully private, one on one, and tailored around your health, your mind, and your life.

Whether you are seeking a luxury wellness retreat, private detox retreat, executive burnout recovery, or a confidential mental health retreat, every program is created around you and delivered with complete discretion.

Since 2009, Alive has supported high performing individuals, entrepreneurs, executives, families, and private clients from around the world through our proven 360 degree holistic approach. We work across the whole person, combining advanced wellness, detox, coaching, therapy, healing, and full life integration to create powerful results that last.
This is not a standard retreat. It is a five star private retreat experience designed for those who expect the best.

Alive Luxury Retreats is planning its UAE location for the future. Until then, guests from the UAE and Gulf region can experience our private luxury retreats in Bali or Mexico, with full support to design a retreat that feels seamless, confidential, and completely tailored to you.
